identified_root_causes: Citation instructions lacked explicit punctuation and tagging rules for tests ['TC-010', 'TC-014', 'TC-015']; Refusal boundary ambiguity caused misclassified inquiries on tests ['TC-001', 'TC-002', 'TC-005', 'TC-006', 'TC-013', 'TC-016']; Model extrapolated unsupported details when context was partial on tests ['TC-011', 'TC-012']

changes_applied.content: MANDATORY CITATION RULE: Every statement of fact MUST end with an explicit citation tag in the format [Source: <document_name>]. If multiple documents apply, list each source tag.

REFUSAL BOUNDARY RULE: Only refuse questions that clearly fall outside the supported documentation scope. For supported topics, search the context thoroughly and synthesize the answer before concluding refusal.
changes_applied.new_value: clarified refusal criteria and required evidence synthesis

changes_applied.content: STRICT GROUNDING CONSTRAINT: Never guess, extrapolate, or assume numbers or dates not explicitly written in the text. If a specific figure is missing from context, state that it is not documented.
changes_applied.new_value: added explicit prohibition against extrapolating figures
changes_applied.reason: Prevent unsupported factual claims in tests: ['TC-011', 'TC-012']

reason_for_each_change: Targeted adjustments addressing specific diagnosed failure modes without full regeneration.
